source.dataset: WLASL v0.3 index (C-UDA) -> third-party ASL dictionary video

creation_method: Monocular video retargeting: MediaPipe PoseLandmarker/HandLandmarker world landmarks (Savitzky-Golay smoothed, gaps interpolated) -> same G1 retargeting as the mocap clips (scaled shoulder-relative wrist targets, bounded 7-DoF IK per arm with clearance, finger flexion from joint positions)
limitations: Inspire fingers have no abduction; spread handshapes (e.g. V, 3) cannot be reproduced
Finger and thumb mapping use fixed flexion ranges, not per-signer calibration
Torso, head and face motion are not transferred; robot base is fixed
Shoulder-relative scaling does not preserve exact hand-to-hand or hand-to-body contacts; hand-hand clearance is enforced, so contacts become touching at best
Hanging rest poses deviate a few cm because the human hand rests lower than the robot hip allows
Depth (towards/away from the camera) is estimated from a single view and is the least reliable axis
Hands undetected in some frames are interpolated; finger flexion is noisier than mocap
Source videos are third-party dictionary clips indexed by WLASL (C-UDA); they are not redistributed
